# FolderPilot test suite.
# Framework: doctest, vendored in third_party/doctest (pinned release v2.5.3).

add_executable(folderpilot_tests
    test_main.cpp
    phase3_fixture.cpp
    unit/test_smoke.cpp
    unit/test_category.cpp
    unit/test_rules.cpp
    unit/test_classifier.cpp
    unit/test_text.cpp
    unit/test_native.cpp
    unit/test_handle.cpp
    unit/test_path_guard.cpp
    unit/test_scanner.cpp
)

# doctest is third-party code: the SYSTEM include keeps warnings generated by
# the vendored header out of our build output. Project sources keep full
# warnings.
target_include_directories(folderpilot_tests
    SYSTEM PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/doctest
)

target_link_libraries(folderpilot_tests PRIVATE
    folderpilot_build_options
    folderpilot_core
    folderpilot_platform
)

# Phase 3 filesystem fixtures live under the workspace build directory -
# never %TEMP%, never any user folder.
target_compile_definitions(folderpilot_tests PRIVATE
    FOLDERPILOT_PHASE3_SANDBOX="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/phase3-test-sandbox"
)

# One CTest entry point: the doctest binary runs all registered cases.
add_test(NAME unit_tests COMMAND folderpilot_tests)
